text:
dev-docs: small onboarding cleanup for the sparklet quickstart: standardize env names, add a single-file Docker run example, and migrate Node/Python snippets to SDK6. I'll split into 3 tiny PRs for fast review.
rachel: please make the env table explicit: VAR -> meaning -> example. Add a row for '401 after rotation' troubleshooting.
pietro: I'll add the Dockerfile + run command. prefer `docker run --env-file .env -p 3000:3000 sparklet` in the docs to keep things simple.
mina: I'll update Node snippets to SDK6 and include a one-line streaming pointer (link). Also add Windows `setx` example for env.
ci-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4750 - "sparklet: env table + links" by dev-docs
ci-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4751 - "sparklet: Dockerfile + run" by pietro
ci-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4752 - "snippets: node & python sdk6" by mina
qa-bot: add smoke test that hits /health and a simple generate; retry 3x.
rachel: small nit: remove hardcoded stage URL, show REDWOOD_API_HOST variable instead and call out Private/Dedicated differences (host + X-Account-ID).
pietro: Dockerfile snippet I'll add:
```
FROM node:18-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --production
COPY . .
CMD ["node","index.js"]
```
pi: run example: `docker build -t sparklet . && docker run --env-file .env -p 3000:3000 sparklet`
mina: Node compact snippet for docs:
```
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const out = await client.generate({ model: 'clarion-mini', prompt: 'Hi' });
console.log(out.text);
```
mina: I'll keep error handling minimal and link to streaming guide.
ci-bot: PR 4750 merged by dev-docs at 1768901290
pietro: rebased 4751 and ran smoke locally; retries pass. Opened tiny follow-up to tweak timeout.
mina: rebased 4752 and updated Node to include minimal try/catch.
dev-docs: final checklist: env table ✅, docker run + smoke ✅, node+py snippets ✅. Will post a short release note in #onboarding.
